definitions: A type of field in a database or application that establishes a relationship between two objects, where one object (the master) controls the detail records of the other object (the detail).
A field used to link a master record to multiple detail records, often seen in user interfaces where selecting a master record displays its associated details.
examples: The master-detail field ensures data integrity.
Configure the master-detail field for the report.
The master-detail field is crucial for the application's functionality.
